newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH KGHM INSTITUTIONAL TRANCHE BIDS REDUCED.
newsitem.headline: POLISH KGHM INSTITUTIONAL TRANCHE BIDS REDUCED.

text.p: Bids for the institutional tranche of the copper firm KGHM were reduced 21.59 percent at a special bourse session for the allocation of the stake on Sunday, the offering's domestic manager said on Sunday.
On Saturday the treasury ministry set the strike price in the institutional offer of 14 million KGHM shares at 21.0 zlotys.

"At a special session on Sunday investors who took part in the book building process were alloted KGHM shares -- all 14 million were alloted," PAP news agency quoted deputy head of the WBK SA brokerage Bogdan Kornacki as saying.
"The average rate of reduction of bids at no lower than 21.0 zlotys was 21.59 percent," he said.
On Monday the domestic small investor tranche of 16 million shares will be alloted to investors at a special bourse session.
